claim: setup_macos.py step_mac_agent_thinking must guard against string model shorthand — openclaw.json agents may use 'model': '<id>' (string) instead of {"primary": ...}. Guard with isinstance(_model, str): return before calling .get('primary'). Without guard: AttributeError crashes start.sh --status silently.

decisions.notes: codex-agent had model: 'openai/gpt-5.5'; _enforce() crashed; fixed in orama-system b1aaff0. Any future string-model agent triggers same bug without the guard.
